There are always many people at the holiday plan. Jack hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Jack wants to be a doctor in the future. We feed the chickens every morning.
Jack plays football with Tom every Sunday. Life is full of small surprises. Tom is interested in drawing. These grapes are sweet and juicy.
Jack bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. Jack learned a lot about music. Jack thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Grandmother told me a story last night.
